metadata.blurb: PillarX is a web3 wallet that allows you to manage your digital assets and interact with the blockchain.

ref.explanation: PillarX supports EIP-7702
PillarX's App Store listing describes PillarX as a self-custodial Web3 wallet for managing crypto across multiple networks.
The PillarX repository README says sign-in uses Privy email login, after which PillarX handles account management infrastructure.
PillarX App Store version history says version 3.19.9 added a service to resolve FIO, Unstoppable Domains, and ENS names.
PillarX says Pulse provides token swaps inside PillarX, powered by Etherspot chain abstraction with no chain switching.
PillarX says Exolix integration enables cross-chain swaps across 200+ blockchains without leaving PillarX.
PillarX says StealthEX integration lets users swap tokens across different blockchains without leaving PillarX.

PillarX PnL tracking shows every asset a user holds, using transaction history, balance calculations, and live market data; users can trade tokens on any supported chain and see Unrealised PnL in My Holdings.
PillarX is licensed under the MIT license
PillarX's App Store privacy label lists Crash Data, Performance Data, and Other Diagnostic Data as collected but not linked to identity.
The PillarX repository includes Sentry dependencies and a sentry:sourcemaps script for the PillarX project.
PillarX's App Store privacy label lists Product Interaction usage data for developer advertising/marketing and analytics.
The PillarX repository includes plausible-tracker and Hypelab SDK dependencies.

Immunefi lists a live Pillar bug bounty program, last updated October 29, 2024, covering Pillar smart-contract assets with direct theft, freezing, governance manipulation, MEV, and insolvency impacts in scope.
PillarX App Store version history documents PIN-code and biometrics-related wallet fixes, including a fixed PIN-code issue and WalletConnect biometrics decision handling.

PillarX's README says local use may require registering Etherspot Bundler API and Etherspot Data Service API keys, indicating hosted account-abstraction/data-service infrastructure rather than an embedded Ethereum L1 light client or a user-selected self-hosted node broadcast path.
Pillar's public security copy for PillarX/Pillar Wallet describes an in-app browser that helps avoid scam sites, but does not document malicious-contract registry checks or contract-risk warnings.
Public PillarX repository search found no Blockaid, Tenderly-risk, phishing, malicious-contract, or scam-alert implementation matching contract-risk warnings.

PillarX is distributed through Apple's App Store under the PillarX: Smart DeFi Wallet listing.
Apple documents that App Store distribution verifies the developer signature and then re-signs the app using an Apple identity before download.

PillarX's README documents running the project locally from a copied `.env` and notes that users may need their own Etherspot and Privy API/app credentials; this does not provide a public deterministic rebuild path for matching released PillarX artifacts.

PillarX's package scripts build with Vite using deployment-specific values such as `CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA` and include Sentry sourcemap upload steps; they document build generation, not reproducible release-artifact verification.
Pillar/PillarX sources describe logging in at pillarx.app or launching from Pillar Wallet, and Google Play listing for the mobile wallet.

The current PillarX App Store listing's release notes (v3.31.1, 09/02/2025) state the app "removed the option to buy and sell using third party sites," and the current description only lists cross-chain swaps and stablecoin gas with no fiat on-ramp.
The same App Store release notes (v3.31.1, 09/02/2025) confirm buy AND sell via third-party providers was removed, so the current shipping PillarX app offers no fiat off-ramp.
No in-app fiat ramp exists in the current PillarX app after buy/sell was removed (v3.31.1, 09/02/2025), so bank transfer is not offered as a ramp payment method.
With in-app buy/sell removed in the current PillarX app (v3.31.1, 09/02/2025), no fiat ramp exists, so card payments are not available in the shipping product.
